info.name: Fullstack Backend API
info.description: Covers all current backend endpoints. Start the backend against the new task_predecessors schema, import this collection, and set baseUrl, email, and password in local collection variables. Use an existing database user. Run the entire collection in order: it creates a uniquely named project and edits it (restoring its budget afterwards), then creates two predecessor tasks, and a dependent task; saves their IDs automatically; verifies blocked execution; executes both predecessors; then verifies and executes the dependent task. Logout runs last. Postman stores session cookies automatically; keep the cookie jar enabled and use the same hostname. WARNING: every full run permanently creates test data, changes budgets/values, and writes audit logs. There are no cleanup/delete endpoints. Use a disposable test environment. For individual requests, run Login first and supply the relevant IDs from existing records or the creation requests. Keep credentials local and never export real passwords.

item.name: 4. Tasks - changes database
item.description: Run after Create project. Creates two unexecuted tasks and one task depending on both, proves it is blocked, executes both predecessors, then executes the dependent task. Initial project budget must cover 40 total cost. On this fresh fixture the final budget is 60 and value is 20. Do not rerun this folder on the same project without choosing unused positions or creating another project. WARNING: writes permanent task and audit records and changes project budget/value.

item.description: All audit endpoints require login, return arrays of log records, and are available to any authenticated user. Results are ordered newest first. Filters with no matching records return an empty array.
